summary: End-to-end validation of the new /api/admin/cruscotto executive dashboard endpoint and the IBAN field on TerapistaProfileInput. Backend pytest: 8/8 passed (auth guard, full schema shape with 6-month revenue array, int types, IBAN persistence via PUT/GET, iban_missing exclusion after saving IBAN). Frontend Playwright: admin login OK, /admin renders Cruscotto with all 6 requested data-testids (cruscotto-kpis, kpi-fatturato-mese, kpi-payout-pendenti, kpi-sessioni-mese, kpi-terapisti-attivi, chart-ricavi-6m, top-terapisti) plus alert-iban-mancante block; bar-chart <svg> is present. /admin/terapisti edit modal exposes data-testid=form-iban, input uppercases + strips spaces on typing (verified with 'it60 x054 2811 ...' → 'IT60X0542811101000000123456'), value persists after save + reopen. Live cruscotto JSON confirms: current_month 9000c, revenue_6m Aug bucket = 9000c/1, top_therapists[Maria Rossi 9000c], iban_missing=0 after IBAN set.

minor.issue: pending_payouts totals therapist_amount only for payment_status=paid AND payout_status!='paid'. Seeded demo tx now has payout_status='paid' (from iter7 mark-paid test), so pending_payouts.count=0 even though the spec expects to demo the 'da bonificare' flow. Consider adding a second unpaid seed tx so the KPI is non-zero for demo purposes.

iban_missing pipeline groups ALL paid tx (not just those without a payout). If a therapist without IBAN has only already-paid-out tx, they still show up — arguably correct for auditing but could be filtered to payout_status!='paid' to be actionable.

issues: Backend returns 9000c for Aug 2026 and the SVG renders, but the Aug bar is visually barely (or not) visible on the screenshot. Y-axis maxes at 100 (€) and the 90€ bar should be nearly full-height; check that recharts Bar dataKey 'ricavi' is being rendered as expected on the last category — could be a category-padding/barCategoryGap issue when only one non-zero bucket exists. Verify in browser during main-agent QA.

action_items: Optional: seed at least one unpaid paid_transaction so pending_payouts KPI and iban_missing show non-zero demo values.
Optional: verify BarChart displays the Aug column at ~90% height. If not, set explicit barCategoryGap or minPointSize on <Bar />.
Optional: filter iban_missing to only therapists with pending_cents>0 to make the alert actionable.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py now ~2660 lines. The cruscotto endpoint is 170+ lines with 5 aggregation pipelines inline — extract into a dedicated router module (routers/admin_analytics.py) and split the aggregations into small helpers.

admin_cruscotto uses `now + timedelta(days=1)` as the upper bound for current-month gross which technically includes 'tomorrow'. Fine for a snapshot dashboard but not for month-close accounting; use next_month_start for correctness.
delta_percent returns None when previous month is 0. UI must handle None (currently shows 'n/d') — good.
iban_missing does an N+1 find_one per group. With many therapists this scales poorly; use $lookup or a single $in query on terapisti after aggregate.
top_therapists likewise N+1. Same fix applies.

update_terapista PUT: `update = {k:v for k,v in data.model_dump().items() if v is not None}` — an empty-string IBAN will overwrite the stored value (which is what we want to clear it), but there's no IBAN format validation on the backend. Consider a light regex check (IT + 25 alnum) to prevent typos silently persisting.
test_credentials: admin@funzionabene.it / admin2026 (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md). Also used demo.paziente@funzionabene.it / paziente2026 for the 403 negative test.
seed_data_creation: None. The IBAN persistence test wrote 'IT60X0542811101000000123456' to Dr. Maria Rossi's therapist record and restored the original at the end. Note the earlier iter7 mark-paid state on tx 6a70adcc133bd008dba636ef (payout_status=paid, therefore pending_payouts=0) is still in effect.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Cruscotto endpoint and IBAN feature are complete and pass all acceptance criteria. Backend test file /app/backend/tests/test_iteration8_cruscotto.py can be reused for regression. Two design points remain worth eyeballing: (1) Aug bar visibility on chart-ricavi-6m when only one non-zero bucket; (2) seed a second unpaid tx so pending_payouts KPI ≠ 0 for demo screenshots.
rca of the issue: No blocking issue. Notable observation: the Aug bar in the 6-month chart appeared visually flat in the Playwright screenshot even though backend data confirms Aug gross_cents=9000 (=90€) and the chart svg is rendered. Root cause is likely ResponsiveContainer + recharts barCategoryGap when only one bucket has data; not a blocker but worth a quick manual visual check.
